contract: DESIGN.md: quiet compliance control desk; one focused task per drawer/dialog; readable dense registers; keyboard-safe responsive layouts across Control Tower, Team, Clients, Work, BIR Center, Admin, and Tax Team.

accessibility.evidence: Axe scanned 30 route/viewport renders plus the dynamic Work detail drawer at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths with zero violations; shared drawers and Work evidence dialogs were exercised with focus containment and Escape handling.

responsive.evidence: Desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots cover all core workspace routes plus dynamic Work detail drawers; mobile navigation, tables, drawers, and action groups were inspected for reflow and horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Route loading boundaries and repository loading/status copy are present in the audited app shell and data surfaces.

empty.evidence: Control Tower, registers, and repository surfaces expose explanatory empty states with a safe next action or clear context.

error.evidence: API-backed surfaces expose specific inline recovery/status messages; the sanitized fallback is explicitly labelled.

partial.evidence: Control and calendar surfaces distinguish missing/unmatched data and preserve unknown tax facts as unresolved rather than inventing values.

success.evidence: Mutation surfaces provide local status feedback and retain history/actor/timestamp context where the workflow requires it.

permission.evidence: Persona-aware navigation and access-state surfaces were traversed; restricted surfaces explain the boundary without exposing unauthorized actions.

renderedEvidence.observation: Control Tower desktop hierarchy, primary navigation, signal card, intervention ledger, and upcoming queue.
Dynamic Work detail drawer at tablet width with timeline, next action, and evidence controls.
Dynamic Work detail drawer at mobile width with full-width sheet treatment and reachable actions.
Tax Team deadline register with filters, dates, status, and publication actions.
Clients mobile register with responsive controls and no keyboard-inaccessible scroll surface.
